messages:
Priya (Account): FYI - SolarisHealth POC next week. They need SSO (SAML), SCIM bulk import (~50k), RBAC sync, domain proofing. Two red flags: contractors arrive via proxy with different NameID and they want a full 'replace' semantics in daily syncs (~400 rps). Need SE + Security input. @Rach @Leah

Rach (SE): Quick ask - is the proxy emitting the same issuer with altered NameID or a separate IdP issuer? That changes alias strategy.

Sam (Prospect): Same Azure tenant for FT staff; contractors go through a proxy that rewrites the NameID format. We can share sample CSV + metadata. Sync window ~8-12m so peak ~350-450 rps.

Amit (Eng): We have an alias mapping (idp_issuer + nameid -> internal_id) which handles multi-format assertions. For SCIM, we recommend staged chunked imports (500/person batch) into our ingest endpoint to avoid 50k concurrent PUTs. Example: curl -X POST https://redwood/api/v1/bulk-import -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -F file=@users.csv

Leah (Security): Security notes: SCIM bearer tokens must support rotation; validate their proxy rotation cadence. Encryption at rest = AES-256; we support AWS/GCP KMS and BYO-KMS for Private. If they require HSM or segregated audit streams advise Private. Also ask if they need domain-level ownership verification for email claims.

Priya (Account): Pricing Q: hosted cost for sustained sync looks high. Can we ballpark Dedicated commit for a PoC (3 months) that covers burst to 450 rps and daily 50k changes?

Rach (SE): Ballpark: short-term Dedicated commit (S-class reserved pool) with burst enabled. Expect mid-five-figure USD/month for that footprint; exact numbers from pricing-ops. Short 3-month demo commitments often possible with uplift.

Amit (Eng): POC config checklist for engineers: enable name_id_aliasing=true, scim_chunk_size=500, scim_throttle=tenant_token_bucket, and alias_write_cooldown=30s to avoid DB churn during initial import. We'll also record audit events for RBAC changes.

Leah (Security): I'll draft the security questionnaire answers: token rotation, audit retention options, KMS/HSM notes, RBAC audit trails. If they insist on HSM-backed keys + separated logs, recommend Private.

ops-bot: ticket POC-12021 created: "SolarisHealth SCIM ingest + NameID aliasing + RBAC mapping" assigned to eng-platform.

Priya (Account): Scheduling 30m tech sync Tue 10am PT with SolarisHealth and SE/security. Sam will upload CSV and metadata beforehand. I'll attach the security questionnaire for prefill.

Sam (Prospect): Will upload CSV + Azure metadata by EOD. One more question: can we start Dedicated as a 90-day commit and convert to annual if we hit SLA targets?

Rach (SE): Yes, we support conversion. Pricing-ops will confirm minimums and prorate. I'll post the exact quote once I hear back.

Priya (Account): Thanks all 44d Closing thread for now; will reopen after ops-quote.
